title: Favorite groups: Ink Spots and Lionel Hampton; avoiding public life
summary: He most enjoyed the Ink Spots and Lionel's group, and stays out of public life because he cannot see well.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And once you find that out -- well, we've been talking a lot about pretty negative things, you know.
I'm just -- since we're talking about it we could turn it around and -- Talk about something else,
-- and talk about if there's any people you remember that you really enjoyed playing with, people that stand out, you know, in your memory, that everything was always cool, you know?
Well, to tell you the truth, the Ink Spots.
And little groups that I would get into around in here.
I wouldn't know the names of them now because they're out of mind, you know.
Yeah. Little things you'd be involved with --
Yeah. Since I stopped going into public life, which I think is best for me right now because I'd be in a whole lot of scrapes and be liable to get hurt because I can't see too much, you know.
Someone would come up to me and do something to me that I couldn't do nothing back to me, see, and that would worry me to death. They might as well kill me.
But I don't go out looking for trouble.
Nobody does, I guess. But they go out and get into it. Just by, you know, being whatever they think they can do.
